statement: On a real normed vector space with measurable open sets and any finite measure, a globally bounded C-infinity real f with compactly supported actual Frechet derivative has integrable squared derivative norm. For all sufficiently small real e, 1+e*f is everywhere at least1/2, u_e=sqrt(1+e*f) is genuinely C-infinity and belongs to L2; both u_e^2 log(u_e^2) and the actual squared derivative norm of u_e are integrable.
